topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session, connects it to histopathology practicals, and outlines the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Assays for Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and how cellular transformation is experimentally assayed.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Classification of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the classification and functional mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes in cell cycle regulation and tumor promotion.

topics.label: Genetic Instability and Multistep Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the molecular causes and cellular consequences of sequence and chromosomal instability and their role in driving multistep tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine inherited cancer predisposition syndromes and the dynamics of tumor evolution in patients carrying germline mutations.

topics.label: Closing Framing and Reading Recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session, offers to answer questions, and provides recommended reading for the break.
